text:
maya: FYI I opened a consolidation PR to replace several small 429/timeout/context-limit pages with a single canonical error-ref. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4305

samir: Nice. Let's include compact SDK examples for graceful fallback + the recommended retry header so customers have a drop-in. I can add Node + Python.

lisa: Also include a short migration note for teams using legacy short-circuit retries. They were hitting double-retries after switching handlers. Recommend header X-RI-Retry-Mode=graceful and a brief sentence.

samir: Draft Node snippet (short):
```js
// prefer fallback model on 429, preserve idempotency headers
const r = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (r.status === 429) {
  await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful', 'X-RI-Route': 'dedicated' } });
}
```

samir: Draft Python snippet (short):
```py
# short-circuit fallback for 429
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful', 'X-RI-Route': 'dedicated'})
```

jordan: Please add a tiny policy example showing latency/quality tradeoff. Keep it minimal for docs readers.

jordan: policy example:
```json
{ "preferred": "gpt-4-std", "fallback_order": ["gpt-4-small","gpt-3.5-lite"], "max_latency_ms": 400 }
```

lisa: For context limits: show a before/after prompt trimming example and recommend trimming non-essential user messages first, then system anchors. Mention the console helper: `context-trim --preserve=system --max-tokens=2048` as a quick tip.

alex: Edge-case: streaming + 429 during chunked responses. We should add a troubleshooting bullet: if you receive a 429 mid-stream, doc recommends aborting and marking partial as incomplete; if using resumable streaming, attach last-token-offset in X-RI-Resume-Token.

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 2 broken links, 1 style warning. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4599/logs (details in PR check).

samir: I'll take Node snippets + fix SDK links that still point to the old retry page. Will push follow-up commit.

lisa: I'll author migration paragraph + context-trim before/after examples. ETA tomorrow AM.

maya: Who can run the link-sweep after we merge? There are some internal cross-links in devex and SDK pages that need to redirect.

jordan: I can scan product and SDK pages and file redirects. Will call out any ambiguous cases here.

maya: Target merge Friday COB after CI fixes. Add a troubleshooting bullet for streaming partials + 429 (alex's note) and a one-line observability example showing `X-RI-Route` so support can correlate fallback events.

alex: Also suggest a tiny trace header example: `X-RI-Trace=team-id:request-id` for easier query in tracing.

maya: Added to checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
